caption:
This is the lift line at one of our home resorts on a Tuesday in January.

No queue, no competition for the first chair, and the snow between the trees stays untouched until lunch. It's the main reason we based ourselves in central Hokkaido instead of the famous names down south.

Small resorts, small groups, big snow. Send us a message if you want to see the week for yourself.
